Part of the **guardian role**, so it moved from WP4 to WP7 (milestone M4) in the 2026-11-13 reorder: design §9.4 excludes it from the minimal pull-over island. This issue collects the discussion and records what the WG decides.

> **Note, added after the meeting:** the plan was reordered on 2026-11-13: the pull-over island first, then the guardian role and ODD degradation, lane hold last. **Work-package numbers in the questions below are those from before the reorder.** Old → new: WP6 (B2 lane hold) → **WP9** · WP7 (B3 pull over) → **WP6** · WP8 (B1 and guardian) → **WP7** · WP9 (B6 / B5) → **WP8**; `I8` moved from WP4 to WP7. The reorder answers two points below: the minimal pull-over path no longer depends on B2 (B3 is built without `N5`, design §9.4), and `I8` now sits with the guardian role. See [MILESTONES.md §2](https://github.com/autowarefoundation/L4SafetyIsland_Implementation/blob/main/docs/MILESTONES.md#2-what-the-order-changes-and-why-it-stays-inside-the-design). The open questions are left unticked for the WG.
